_comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): Dresk's REAL conversation graph, replacing the old repeated-forever dialogue[0] fallback (skeleton_scene.json's own comment on duty_sergeant flagged him 'not a quest-giver v1' -- this is that v2). POSTING-SEEDED: the 'ask' option is hidden until guild_board's rumor_missing_recruit has been read (heard_about_missing_recruit). Two real beats: 'search' (banked on the sewers map, recruit_pell.json) and 'report' (banked here, same map as the giver -- no travel-signposting requirement). Always-available exit: 'Just checking in.' carries neither requires nor hide_when.

hub.speaker: Dresk
hub.text: Sergeant Ashgrave. If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall. Write it plain.

text_variants.text: Still no word from Pell. Kit's counted twice over on account of it. Slate stays open till someone finds them.
Pell's back on the roster, thanks to you. Kit's counted, slate's closed. Good day, officially, this time.

options.text: I found Pell. Safe, just turned around.

explain.speaker: Dresk
explain.text: Pell. Green, keen, checks every noise personally instead of logging it and moving on. Went to look at scratching in the drainage gallery two musters back. Hasn't reported since. Not panicking. Yet.

thanks.speaker: Dresk
thanks.text: Turned around, not hurt. That's the good version of this story. Four gold, out of my own kit budget — the Guild doesn't pay for finding my own people. Pell owes you a drink they can't afford yet.
